svg.aria-label: A simple sky seen from the side: blue sky above the horizon, (0.10, 0.20, 0.40); dark ground below, (0.04, 0.03, 0.02); and a sunset, a patch of 0.2 steradians just above the horizon toward +X, (3.0, 1.2, 0.3).
